subject: Salem Street Corridor Rezoning
overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee met with consultants Innes Associates to review proposed zoning ordinance updates for the Salem Street Corridor under Paper 24-033. No formal committee action was taken, and discussion will continue at the next committee meeting.

items.title: Presentation on Salem Street Corridor Zoning Updates (Paper 24-033)
items.summary: Innes Associates presented a draft zoning proposal for the Salem Street Corridor that establishes distinct mixed-use and multi-unit residential sub-districts, outlines dimensional standards, and sets a 2025 schedule for reviewing other city districts.

items.title: Committee Discussion on Salem Street Zoning
items.summary: Councilors discussed the proposal, highlighting how it corrects existing zoning loopholes such as high-rise allowances, preserves residential blocks, and supports neighborhood commercial nodes.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents offered feedback on traffic congestion, parking availability, housing needs, building heights, and street design along the Salem Street Corridor.
